_meta.note: story-scene's own presentation pacing (feel only). Nothing here is a balance number: a scene's content, its beats and its copy are authored data (sceneScript), and every structural consequence of the layout lives in web/fusion-rpg-web/src/ui/story-scene/storySceneTokens.ts instead. beatTransitionMs is the beat cross-fade; lineRevealPerCharMs is a per-character reveal where 0 means instant (the shipped default -- a typewriter is opt-in); autoAdvanceMs is null on purpose, because auto-advance steals reading time and is the cousin of the documented unskippable-cutscene failure mode, so enabling it must be a deliberate owner decision; maxBeatsPerScene bounds AUTHORED content so a scene needing more is two scenes -- it is not a population reading and must never be asserted as the shipped script's own beat count.
